questions.text: What is the largest continent in the world?
What is the capital of Japan?
questions.hostNotes: Not Kyoto, the old imperial capital.

questions.text: In which city is the Eiffel Tower?
What is the capital of South Korea?
questions.hostNotes: Not Pyongyang, the capital of North Korea, or Busan.

questions.text: What is the highest mountain in the world above sea level?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Everest, Sagarmatha, Chomolungma.

questions.text: Which European country is shaped like a boot?
Which country is home to the Great Wall?
The Taj Mahal is in which country?
questions.hostNotes: It is in the city of Agra.

questions.text: In which city is the clock tower known as Big Ben?
questions.hostNotes: Big Ben is strictly the name of the bell inside.

questions.text: In which country is the Sydney Opera House?
What is the largest desert in Africa?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Sahara Desert. Not the Kalahari.

questions.text: What is the coldest continent?
What city-state at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula is a major Asian financial hub?
What great river flows north through Egypt into the Mediterranean Sea?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Nile River.

questions.text: What is the smallest country in the world?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Vatican, Holy See. It lies inside Rome.

questions.text: What is the largest country in the world by land area?
questions.hostNotes: Not Canada, which is second.

questions.text: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.hostNotes: Not Sydney or Melbourne.

questions.text: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.hostNotes: Not Toronto or Vancouver.

questions.text: What is the capital of Vietnam?
questions.hostNotes: Not Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), the largest city.

questions.text: What is the capital of the United Arab Emirates?
questions.hostNotes: Not Dubai, the largest city.

questions.text: What is the main language spoken in Brazil?
questions.hostNotes: Not Spanish.

questions.text: What canal connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Suez.

questions.text: What canal in Central America links the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Panama.

questions.text: What is the largest island in the world?
questions.hostNotes: Australia is counted as a continent, not an island.

questions.text: What large island off southeast Africa is the only natural home of lemurs?
Which South American river carries more water than any other river in the world?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Amazon River.

questions.text: What mountain range runs along the whole western side of South America?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Andes Mountains. It is the longest continental mountain range in the world.

questions.text: Which Turkish city lies on both sides of the Bosphorus, in Europe and in Asia?
questions.hostNotes: Formerly Constantinople. Not Ankara, the capital.

questions.text: The temple complex of Angkor Wat is in which country?
questions.hostNotes: It appears on Cambodia's national flag.

questions.text: Which Scandinavian country is famous for its deep coastal inlets called fjords?
questions.hostNotes: Not Sweden or Finland.

questions.text: What cold desert covers much of Mongolia and northern China?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Gobi Desert.

questions.text: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.hostNotes: Not Istanbul, the largest city.

questions.text: What is the capital of New Zealand?
questions.hostNotes: Not Auckland, the largest city.

questions.text: What salt lake between Israel and Jordan has the lowest land elevation on Earth?
Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest mountain, is in which country?
questions.hostNotes: Not Kenya, though it is near the border.

questions.text: What narrow strait separates Spain from Morocco?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Gibraltar.

questions.text: Which river flows through Baghdad?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Tigris River. Not the Euphrates, its twin river.

questions.text: Which country has the only national flag that is not four-sided?
questions.hostNotes: It is made of two stacked triangles. Not Switzerland or Vatican City, whose flags are square.

questions.text: Which mountain range in Russia is traditionally the boundary between Europe and Asia?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Urals. Not the Caucasus.

questions.text: What Siberian lake is the deepest lake in the world?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Baikal.

questions.text: What Venezuelan waterfall is the world's tallest uninterrupted waterfall?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Kerepakupai Merú, Salto Ángel. Not Niagara or Victoria Falls.

questions.text: The Prime Meridian, 0° longitude, passes through which London district?
The historic desert city of Timbuktu is in which African country?
What is the largest country in Africa by area?
questions.hostNotes: Not Sudan, which was largest until South Sudan split off in 2011.

questions.text: Which small kingdom is completely surrounded by South Africa?
questions.hostNotes: Not Eswatini (Swaziland), which also borders Mozambique.
